title: Tiny, cute anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ring at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- small connecting piece between ring and stock -->
  <rect x='46' y='22' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- stock (horizontal bar) -->
  <rect x='28' y='30' width='44' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ef476f'/>
  <!-- vertical shank -->
  <rect x='46' y='36' width='8' height='44' rx='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- curved bottom flukes -->
  <path d='M20 64 Q22 82 40 86 L40 78 Q28 75 27 64 Z' fill='#06d6a0'/>
  <path d='M80 64 Q78 82 60 86 L60 78 Q72 75 73 64 Z' fill='#06d6a0'/>
  <!-- bottom tip -->
  <path d='M44 80 L50 90 L56 80 Z' fill='#06d6a0'/>
  <!-- cute little face on the shank -->
  <circle cx='45.5' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#118ab2'/>
  <circle cx='54.5' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#118ab2'/>
  <path d='M46 57 Q50 60 54 57' fill='none' stroke='#118ab2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek glows -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='56' r='2' fill='#ef476f' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='56' r='2' fill='#ef476f' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
